reviews.rationale: Selected GAAP rows from the two SEC exhibits are directionally favorable on the profit lines: revenue rose sequentially while total expenses fell, and earnings before income taxes, net earnings and diluted EPS all increased on the same basis. The one clearly opposing selected row is interest on funds held for clients, a client-funds revenue line that declined sequentially, which is consistent with a softer contribution from client-funds interest and tempers the revenue picture. The selected rows do not identify the drivers of the expense decline or the revenue mix, do not separate recurring from one-time items, do not provide non-GAAP or company-defined measures, do not include guidance, and do not establish year-over-year direction; the comparison is sequential displayed-value arithmetic only. Because the extract cannot support a defensible causal or durability view, the research state is held for review rather than upgraded, and the thesis remains blocked pending a fuller filing-based reconciliation.
